title: ExecutionReceipt
description: Canonical execution identity and result, rebuilt against the MDP formal model (A0-T2). What actually executed, whether it succeeded, and (where required) the resulting target post-state - kept separate from lifecycle/DecisionOutcome/DecisionStage (CLAUDE.md Section 9). Derived convenience fields (postStateMatchesExpected, feeAccounting, displaySummary) are clearly additional and never replace the canonical identity fields.

actionId.description: Unambiguous link back to the ActionEnvelope this receipt executes (CLAUDE.md Section 9.6).

adapterId.description: Identity of the Target Adapter that carried out the bounded action.

parentTxId.description: The Kernel-effect transaction that authorized this execution (parent of childTx where applicable, CLAUDE.md Section 9.5).

finalStatus.description: Derived-but-canonical final execution status. FINALIZED lifecycle + FINISHED_WITH_ERROR execution result MUST map to FAILURE, never SUCCESS (TM-LIFE-002, CLAUDE.md Section 9.4).

preStateHash.description: Hash of target-relevant state immediately before execution, where obtainable.

postStateHash.description: Hash of target-relevant state immediately after execution, where obtainable.

expectedPostStateRequired.description: Whether this actionType requires post-state verification before it may be displayed/treated as a genuine success (CLAUDE.md Section 9.6).

postStateMatchesExpected.description: Derived convenience field only - never a substitute for preStateHash/postStateHash/finalStatus.

displaySummary.description: Derived human-display convenience field only - never replaces the raw canonical fields (CLAUDE.md Section 23).

allOf.description: A0 final remediation (A5): every non-success executionResult maps to FAILURE, never SUCCESS or UNKNOWN.
A0 final remediation (A5): NOT_VOTED (no execution actually occurred) can never be presented as SUCCESS.

A0 final remediation (A5): finalStatus SUCCESS may only be reached via FINISHED_WITH_RETURN - the reverse direction of the FINISHED_WITH_RETURN rule below, closing the loophole where some other executionResult claimed SUCCESS.

A0 final remediation (A5): where post-state verification is required for this actionType, SUCCESS additionally requires actual post-state proof - a return value alone is not enough (CLAUDE.md Section 9.6).
